channel.title: Department of Business, Economic Development & Tourism

item.title: DBEDT E-newsletter – September 2026
item.dc:creator: David Hiromoto
item.description: Hawaii has endured multiple disasters in recent months and DBEDT is working with partners to support business recovery while strengthening long term economic resilience. Learn more about how we are administering recovery grants, expanding access to resources and guiding the Hawaii Economic Development Working Group as it develops a strategic roadmap for Hawaii’s future

item.title: DBEDT Releases 2025 State of Hawaii Data Book
item.dc:creator: David Hiromoto
item.description: DBEDT today released the 2025 edition of the State of Hawaii Data Book, marking the 58th edition of its long-standing series.

item.title: August 2026 Visitor Spending and Arrivals Declined
item.dc:creator: David Hiromoto
item.description: Total spending by visitors in August 2026 was $1.59 billion (measured in nominal dollars), a 9.7 percent decline compared to August 2025, according to preliminary statistics from DBEDT.

item.title: DBEDT Policy Forum Highlights Newly Released Hawaii-Japan Economic Data
item.dc:creator: David Hiromoto
item.description: DBEDT, in partnership with the Hawaii Institute for Public Affairs and the Japan-America Society of Hawaii, hosted a public policy forum yesterday to highlight findings from the newly released 2026 Hawaii–Japan Economic Report

item.title: 2025/2026 Hawaii Green Business Awards Program Honors Local Businesses and Events for Sustainability Practices
item.dc:creator: David Hiromoto
item.description: Hawaii State Energy Office — The Hawaii Green Business Program recognized 51 Hawaii businesses and events last night for their commitment to energy and water efficiency, waste reduction, pollution prevention and community involvement, as well as cultural and natural resource preservation.

item.title: Scam Alert: State Warns Public About Fraudulent Letters Referencing a State Agency
item.dc:creator: David Hiromoto
item.description: Hawaii Green Infrastructure Authority — DBEDT and Hawaii Green Infrastructure Authority, in partnership with the Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs Office of Consumer Protection, is alerting Hawaii residents to a series of fraudulent mailers that use HGIA’s name to imply legitimacy in home warranty and mortgage protection scams.

item.title: Hawaii August Unemployment Rate at 2.7 Percent
item.dc:creator: David Hiromoto
item.description: DBEDT today announced that the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate for August was 2.7 percent, the same as in July.

item.title: DBEDT Brings Business Resources to Entrepreneurs Statewide
item.dc:creator: David Hiromoto
item.description: UPDATE: Due to ongoing recovery efforts taking place, the Kauai workshop that was scheduled for Oct. 1 has been postponed. New event details will be announced. The Hawaii Island events happened today, while the Maui and Oahu events are proceeding as planned.

item.title: DBEDT E-newsletter – August 2026
item.dc:creator: David Hiromoto
item.description: This issue provides updates on Hawaii’s storm response and recovery efforts, highlights DBEDT’s long term economic development initiatives, and shares recent activities supporting local businesses, aquaculture, tourism, trade, and workforce development. It also recognizes community programs, upcoming export workshops, and DBEDT team members honored for their contributions.

item.title: DBEDT Projects 1.3 Percent Growth for 2026
item.dc:creator: David Hiromoto
item.description: DBEDT released its third quarter of 2026 Statistical and Economic Report today. DBEDT projects Hawaii’s economy to grow 1.3 percent in 2026, decreasing from 2.5 percent growth in 2025.
